final: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(CAST(l.derived_total_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(l.derived_product_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(l.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items l ON l.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10
